text: SOE agents kept their keys in a memorised poem: a few words written out, their letters numbered alphabetically, used to shuffle the message twice through a grid. The sculpture's solved text is a poem its makers knew by heart.

Every run of 1-6 consecutive words of K1, K2, K3 and the Morse as the key, used twice or split in two, each shuffle undone, then a repeating key of 1-26 on the sculpture's tables before or after; 15 scrambled copies.
Nothing fits K4 better than the copies. F11.2 closed for consecutive words; free picks of words remain untested.
